svg.title: robot_hand: breadboard view
svg.desc: Generated by Text to Robot from the robot's wiring record (design.wiring). Each wire carries data-wire, its colour is the wire colour in WIRING.md.
svg.text: Every wire of WIRING.md, in its colour, from pin to pin. Grey bundles are bought leads (USB, camera ribbon).
IEC C14 panel inlet with fuse drawer and rocker switch
